item.text: {"summary":"The failures cluster around splitting signed epoch durations into whole seconds and subseconds. The current formatter excerpt contains a special adjustment for nonpositive remainders, but the available evidence does not establish how that interacts with calendar conversion, duration ratios, or minimum-value handling. Please provide the current implementations and contracts for those paths before repair.","hypotheses":["System-time formatting uses inconsistent whole-second and subsecond normalization for negative or fractional epoch durations, producing incorrect calendar fields and fractions.","The formatter's nonpositive-remainder adjustment or subsecond conversion mishandles signed values, including the minimum nanosecond count.","Calendar conversion or duration-ratio casting loses a carry or borrow at fractional-second and large-date boundaries."],"queries":["gmtime(sys_time","auto second()","write_fractional_seconds","safe_duration_cast"],"reads":[{"path":"include/fmt/chrono.h","line":475,"symbol":"gmtime"},{"path":"include/fmt/chrono.h","line":2171,"symbol":"formatter<sys_time<Duration>, Char>::format"},{"path":"include/fmt/chrono.h","line":1320,"symbol":"tm_writer"},{"path":"include/fmt/chrono.h","line":414,"symbol":"duration_cast"}],"ready":false}
